{"edit_description":"Create a NEW self-contained HTML file at this exact path (file does not exist yet; create it from scratch). Single file: HTML + CSS + vanilla JavaScript + dat.gui only. No frameworks, modules, or assets except the dat.gui CDN script.

PURPOSE: Animated neon neuron-network growth simulation on an 800x800 canvas, with a dat.gui control panel. Futuristic, high-contrast, glowing, slightly gritty look. Do NOT reference any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style anywhere in code or comments. No images or textures.

LAYOUT / CSS:
- <body> margin 0, background #030510, display flex, align-items center, justify-content center, min-height 100vh.
- Exactly one <canvas id="net" width="800" height="800"> centered, with CSS border 1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.25), border-radius 4px, box-shadow 0 0 70px rgba(0,229,255,0.14).
- Optional small monospace caption above or below the canvas in color #ffd400 with letter-spacing.

EXACT PALETTE (defaults):
- background #05070f, background glow #101a3a, main branch #00e5ff, accent branch #d6ff00, synapse #ff2bd6, pulse #fff36a, UI accent #ffd400, grid/scanline rgba(0,229,255,0.08).

CODE STRUCTURE — separate sections with short comments: SETUP, GUI SETUP, NEURON GROWTH, SYNAPSE DETECTION, PULSE ANIMATION, RENDERING, MAIN LOOP. Compact but readable (~350-450 lines). Use requestAnimationFrame with clamped dt (max 0.05s).

SETUP:
- Get canvas + 2d context, W=800 H=800.
- Params object P with defaults: neuronCount 5, branchSpeed 40, maxDepth 6, splitChance 0.65, curvature 0.45, maxBranchLength 180, synapseDistance 26, synapseGlow 18, pulseSpeed 170, pulseFrequency 2.2, pulseBrightness 1.1, background '#05070f', branch '#00e5ff', accent '#d6ff00', synapse '#ff2bd6', pulse '#fff36a', showGrid true, showScanlines true.
- State: arrays branches, tips, synapses, pulses, neurons; Set synKeys; const MAX_BRANCHES = 400; paused flag; time accumulator; synapseScan timer; pulseTimer.

GUI SETUP (dat.gui):
- Folder "Growth": neuronCount (3–6 step 1), branchSpeed (5–150), maxDepth (2–10 step 1), splitChance (0–1), curvature (0–1.5), maxBranchLength (60–400).
- Folder "Synapses": synapseDistance (10–80), synapseGlow (0–40).
- Folder "Pulses": pulseSpeed (40–400), pulseFrequency (0.2–8), pulseBrightness (0.2–2.5).
- Folder "Visuals": addColor for background, branch, accent, synapse, pulse; checkboxes showGrid, showScanlines.
- Top-level buttons: "regenerate network" (calls regenerate), "clear canvas" (empties all arrays + synKeys), "pause/resume animation" (toggles paused; label stays static).
- dat.gui loaded via <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js">.

NEURON GROWTH:
- Branch object: {x, y, angle, depth, len, maxLen, width, accent (bool), neuron (index), pts: [{x,y}], done (bool), flick (random phase), id}.
- regenerate(): clear all state; create P.neuronCount seed neurons at random positions within ±150 px of canvas center, store {x, y}; for each, create one starting branch: random angle, depth 0, maxLen = P.maxBranchLength * (0.7 + 0.3*random), width 1.8 + random*0.8, pts starts at seed point.
- updateGrowth(dt): for each branch where !done: step = P.branchSpeed * dt; angle += (Math.random()-0.5) * P.curvature * 0.6 (organic random walk); advance x/y by cos/sin * step; len += step; if moved more than 5px since last recorded point, push point; when len >= maxLen OR point leaves canvas (12px margin): mark done, push to tips; then if branches.length < MAX_BRANCHES and depth < P.maxDepth: if Math.random() < P.splitChance spawn 2 child branches at parent angle ± (0.35 + random*0.55) rad, maxLen = parent.maxLen * (0.62 + random*0.15), width = parent.width * 0.75 (min 0.6), depth+1, one child may flip accent color; additionally with 15% chance spawn one extra small side branch (maxLen * 0.35, width * 0.6).
- Occasionally during growth (chance ~0.006 per frame per active branch, when depth < maxDepth and count < MAX_BRANCHES) spawn a small side branch from the current point (smaller maxLen/width).
- Growth stops naturally when no active branches remain (stable network); pulse animation continues afterwards.

SYNAPSE DETECTION:
- Run on a 0.3s timer (not every frame): for each pair of done tips belonging to DIFFERENT neurons, if distance < P.synapseDistance: build key from sorted tip ids; skip if synKeys has it; else push synapse {a, b, ax, ay, bx, by, len, seed: random*10} and add key. This prevents duplicates.

PULSE ANIMATION:
- pulseTimer += dt; when it exceeds 1 / P.pulseFrequency: pick a RANDOM synapse and random direction (swap endpoints) — this randomly activates different paths over time; spawn pulse {s, t: 0, dir, seed: random*10}; reset timer (subtract interval).
- Update each pulse: p.t += P.pulseSpeed * dt / Math.max(20, s.len); remove when t > 1.
- Pulse position: linear interpolation between the two synapse endpoints plus perpendicular sinusoidal wobble offset = Math.sin(t*14 + p.seed*6) * 3.5 (compute perpendicular from the endpoint vector).

RENDERING (draw() each frame, full redraw):
1. fillRect whole canvas with P.background.
2. Background glow: radial gradient centered (400,400) radius ~480, from rgba built from #101a3a with alpha ~0.55 to transparent; fill.
3. If showGrid: 1px grid lines every 40px, strokeStyle rgba(0,229,255,0.08).
4. If showScanlines: horizontal 1px fillRect lines every 4px with rgba(0,0,0,0.16) for grit, plus one slowly drifting brighter scan band at y = (time*30) % 800, fill rgba(0,229,255,0.05), height 2px.
5. Branches: for each branch with >= 2 pts: strokeStyle = accent ? P.accent : P.branch, same shadowColor, shadowBlur 10, lineWidth = b.width, globalAlpha = 0.55 + 0.25 * Math.sin(time*2 + b.flick) (subtle flicker); draw with quadratic smoothing: moveTo pts[0], for i in 1..pts.length-2 quadraticCurveTo(pts[i], midpoint of pts[i] and pts[i+1]), then lineTo final point; stroke; reset shadow/alpha after.
6. Synapses: thin translucent line (globalAlpha ~0.35, lineWidth 1) in P.synapse between the two tips; then a glowing midpoint node: radius 2.5 + Math.sin(time*2.5 + seed) * 1.2, fillStyle P.synapse, shadowColor P.synapse, shadowBlur = P.synapseGlow (synapses glow brighter than branches).
7. Neuron seed cores: each neuron drawn as glow dot radius 4 in #ffd400 with shadowBlur 16 plus faint halo radius 10 at alpha 0.25.
8. Pulses: draw a short fading trail (3-4 short line segments behind current position) then bright core circle radius ~2.5 in P.pulse with shadowBlur = 14 * P.pulseBrightness and globalAlpha scaled by min(1, P.pulseBrightness); add tiny near-white center dot.
9. Vignette LAST: radial gradient centered (400,400), inner radius ~260 transparent to outer ~560 rgba(0,0,0,0.5); fill entire canvas.
Always reset shadowBlur = 0 and globalAlpha = 1 after glow drawing.

MAIN LOOP:
- rAF loop: compute clamped dt; if (!paused) { time += dt; updateGrowth; synapse scan timer; pulse spawn/update; } then draw() — but when paused, skip both update and draw so the frame freezes (still keep requesting frames).
- Call regenerate() once on load.

Everything inside one <script> at the end of <body>. HTML5 doctype, title like "Neon Neuron Growth". Keep code simple, compact, with short section comments.","path":"neuron_growth_zai-glm-5.3_01.html"}
